n78aa0919fb.headline: Central Bank of Azerbaijan cracks down with binding orders to insurers and experts
n78aa0919fb.summary: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan has issued mandatory enforcement orders to Qala Insurance and AzInsurance following a recent review.
n78aa0919fb.why: The central bank acts as the regulator of Azerbaijan's financial sector, and enforcement orders affect insurer solvency and policyholder confidence.

nc7929a3946.headline: Brussels targets tobacco products with a new set of eurotaxes
nc7929a3946.summary: The European Commission announced a renewed push to curb tobacco use through higher taxation in two separate announcements. The move is expected to raise cigarette and tobacco prices across the EU.
nc7929a3946.why: EU excise duties on tobacco set retail prices and tax revenue, directly affecting tobacco manufacturers and the consumer goods sector.

n0d7e9a3be4.headline: Couche-Tard drops its takeover bid for 7-Eleven
n0d7e9a3be4.summary: Canada's Alimentation Couche-Tard has withdrawn its $47 billion offer for the owner of 7-Eleven, ending a months-long pursuit of the Japanese convenience store giant.
n0d7e9a3be4.why: Couche-Tard is a Canadian convenience store and fuel retailer, and Seven & i Holdings is the Tokyo-based parent of 7-Eleven, one of the world's largest convenience store chains.

impacts.name: Alimentation Couche-Tard
impacts.why: The company dropped its takeover offer, so the acquisition it had pursued will not proceed.

n7a4910f95d.headline: Ram Trucks Australia celebrates 30,000 deliveries of its big American pickup trucks
n7a4910f95d.summary: Ram Trucks has delivered its 30,000th vehicle in Australia as it marks a decade of local operations selling American pickup trucks.
n7a4910f95d.why: Ram is a pickup truck brand owned by Stellantis, and its sales volumes in markets such as Australia form part of the group's regional performance.

n4463f1fda8.headline: Hexaware acquires SMC Squared, a Leader in Building Global Capability Centers
n4463f1fda8.summary: Hexaware Technologies, a global IT solutions provider, has announced it is acquiring SMC Squared, a leader in building global capability centres.
n4463f1fda8.why: Hexaware is an Indian IT services company, and acquisitions in this field expand its consulting and offshore delivery capabilities for global clients.

ne93a5c32a8.headline: Brazil's top court backs most of Lula's tax hike decree after stalemate with Congress
ne93a5c32a8.summary: Brazil's highest court upheld most of a presidential decree raising the financial operations tax (IOF), a revenue-boosting win for the Lula government after a stalemate with Congress.
ne93a5c32a8.why: The IOF is a tax on financial transactions, so changes to it affect credit costs and government revenue in Brazil's public finances.

n99a49d5ad4.headline: Mitsotakis Rendezvous at Thessaloniki Fair Promises Economic Measures
n99a49d5ad4.summary: Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis hints at major economic announcements at the Thessaloniki International Fair. The measures are expected to target pensions, wages and tax relief.
n99a49d5ad4.why: Greece's government economic policy on pensions, wages and taxes shapes household spending and public finances, which matter for Greek bonds and the wider eurozone periphery.

n09fd568122.headline: Azerbaijan, Abu Dhabi strengthen financial oversight links with MoU agreement
n09fd568122.summary: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan signed a memorandum of understanding with the Financial Services Regulatory Authority of Abu Dhabi Global Market. The agreement strengthens financial oversight cooperation.
n09fd568122.why: Memoranda between central banks and financial regulators set out cooperation on supervision, which matters for cross-border capital flows and financial-centre links.

nc4c83fc525.headline: Skyrocketing Student Rents in Greece
nc4c83fc525.summary: Rental prices for student housing in Athens, Piraeus and Thessaloniki have risen sharply. Affordable options are becoming scarcer for students.
nc4c83fc525.why: Rents in Greece's major cities reflect housing supply and demand, which affects household spending and real estate investment. Student housing is a niche within the rental market.

n48cb5640c6.headline: Mandatory E-Invoicing: Tax Incentives for Businesses
n48cb5640c6.summary: New Greek legislation requires electronic invoicing for B2B transactions, public contracts and exports outside the EU. Early adopters will receive tax incentives.
n48cb5640c6.why: Mandatory e-invoicing changes compliance and reporting costs for businesses and gives tax authorities real-time transaction data.

ned27e991f3.headline: Bursa ends higher on regional gains, bargain-hunting
ned27e991f3.summary: Bursa Malaysia closed higher, supported by regional gains and bargain-hunting. Attention turns to key US economic data releases later in the day.
ned27e991f3.why: Bursa Malaysia is the stock exchange of Malaysia, and its benchmark FBM KLCI tracks the country's largest listed companies.

nba1ec8766c.headline: Greece Risks Missing Energy Goals Due to Solar Overload
nba1ec8766c.summary: Ricardo warns that Greece's overreliance on solar power, plus delays in storage and offshore wind, could derail its renewable energy targets by 2030. The warning points to gaps in grid balancing infrastructure.
nba1ec8766c.why: Renewable energy targets shape investment in power generation, storage and grid assets. Delays in storage and offshore wind can affect electricity supply and the returns of energy developers.

n6178b58038.headline: Swatch profits plunge on weak China sales
n6178b58038.summary: Swatch reported a sharp fall in profits, driven by weak sales in China. The watchmaker expects an improved market environment in the second half of the year.
n6178b58038.why: Swatch Group is a Swiss watch and jewellery maker whose results offer a read on global demand for luxury and mid-range timepieces.

nc71fe9b487.headline: House nears vote on cuts to NPR, PBS and foreign aid programs
nc71fe9b487.summary: The Senate approved a $9 billion rescission package early Thursday, and the House is nearing a vote on cuts to NPR, PBS and foreign aid programs. The package targets public broadcasting and foreign assistance funding.
nc71fe9b487.why: Rescission packages cancel previously approved federal spending, affecting government budgets and the agencies and contractors that depend on those funds.

ne06d6d5f12.headline: Why employment figures aren't up to the job
ne06d6d5f12.summary: Unemployment in Scotland has fallen while it has risen in the rest of the UK. The BBC questions whether the labour market figures can be trusted.
ne06d6d5f12.why: UK labour market data shape Bank of England policy expectations, which influence gilt yields and sterling.

n30022081fe.headline: Krispy Kreme records €1.3m loss on lower footfall
n30022081fe.summary: The Irish arm of doughnut maker Krispy Kreme recorded a pre-tax loss of €1.3m last year. Economic conditions hit store footfall and cost pressures rose.
n30022081fe.why: Krispy Kreme is a US-listed doughnut chain whose international units reflect consumer demand and cost trends in local markets.

n3f61443c55.headline: Warm weather hits gravy, soup demand at Premier Foods
n3f61443c55.summary: Premier Foods said warmer weather kept shoppers away from gravy, stock and soup in the first quarter. Revenue rose only marginally and its shares fell 6%.
n3f61443c55.why: Premier Foods is a UK packaged food maker whose brands include Bisto and Oxo, so its trading updates indicate consumer demand in the UK grocery market.
n3f61443c55.why_moved: Warmer weather reduced shopper demand for gravy, stock and soup, leading to only a marginal rise in revenue.

nab2c8866cd.headline: ABB posts record orders on booming US and data centre demand
nab2c8866cd.summary: Swiss engineering group ABB reported its highest-ever quarterly order intake. Surging demand from the United States and for products used in AI data centres drove the result.
nab2c8866cd.why: ABB is a Swiss industrial technology group making electrification, automation and robotics products, and its orders are a read on industrial and data centre investment.

impacts.name: ABB
impacts.why: Record quarterly orders were reported, driven by US and data centre demand.

na7fb2876e1.headline: Aussie shares surge as jobless rise spurs rate cut hope
na7fb2876e1.summary: The Australian sharemarket jumped after the unemployment rate ticked up to 4.3%, raising the odds of an interest rate cut in September.
na7fb2876e1.why: The benchmark ASX 200 is sensitive to Reserve Bank of Australia rate expectations, since lower rates typically support equity valuations.
na7fb2876e1.why_moved: The unemployment rate rose to 4.3%, which increased the odds of an interest rate cut in September and lifted share prices.

n8ff5df399f.headline: UK unemployment jumps to highest since 2021 as wage growth slows
n8ff5df399f.summary: The Office for National Statistics said UK unemployment rose to 4.7% in the three months to May, the highest since 2021, while wage growth slowed.
n8ff5df399f.why: UK labour-market data shape Bank of England rate expectations, which affect gilt yields, sterling and domestic equities.
n8ff5df399f.why_moved: Unemployment rose to 4.7% and wage growth slowed, data that can shift expectations for Bank of England interest rates.

ne1c9742d81.headline: Volvo Cars' Q2 operating profit beats expectations
ne1c9742d81.summary: Volvo Cars reported a sharp fall in second-quarter operating profit that still exceeded analyst expectations, sending shares up. The company faces tariff and demand headwinds.
ne1c9742d81.why: Volvo Cars is a Swedish carmaker with a global premium vehicle business, so its margins are sensitive to tariffs, pricing and demand in key markets.

n37e352cd55.headline: Top NATO commander rushing to deliver fresh Patriots to Ukraine
n37e352cd55.summary: NATO's supreme allied commander is working to deliver Patriot air and missile defence systems to Ukraine, along with other capabilities.
n37e352cd55.why: Defence procurement and military aid flows shape defence contractors' order books and the geopolitical risk premium on European and global assets.

n3739c7b757.headline: 'We're saying no' – house-building boss on timber price hikes
n3739c7b757.summary: New Zealand's busiest house builder says no to timber price rises planned by a timber giant from October 1.
n3739c7b757.why: Timber is a major input cost in residential construction, so supplier price increases feed directly into home-building costs and margins.

nff7bd686d3.headline: Families, kids most at risk of losing HUD housing with Trump’s proposed time limits
nff7bd686d3.summary: A Trump administration proposal could put more than a million low-income households at risk of losing government-subsidized housing, with families and children most affected.
nff7bd686d3.why: HUD administers US federal housing assistance, and changes to eligibility rules affect housing demand and the rental market.

n80a1988867.headline: Majestic Ideal Holdings Limited Announces Pricing of Initial Public Offering and Listing on Nasdaq
n80a1988867.summary: Majestic Ideal Holdings Limited announced pricing of its initial public offering and listing on Nasdaq under the ticker MJID, according to a GlobeNewswire release.
n80a1988867.why: A Nasdaq IPO gives a company access to US public equity capital and creates a new tradable stock for investors.

n6fb6646f41.headline: Germany Vetoes EU Budget Increase and New Corporate Tax
n6fb6646f41.summary: Chancellor Olaf Scholz rejected the EU Commission's proposal for a higher budget and corporate taxes, calling it unacceptable. The position puts Germany against the plan.
n6fb6646f41.why: EU budget size and corporate tax proposals affect member state finances and the bloc's fiscal framework.

ne7019a2f57.headline: Germany Rejects EU Budget Hike and Corporate Tax Plan
ne7019a2f57.summary: Germany vetoed European Commission proposals for an increased EU budget and new corporate taxation for 2028 to 2034, calling them unacceptable. The move blocks the proposed fiscal framework for that period.
ne7019a2f57.why: The EU budget sets spending and contributions across member states, and EU corporate tax rules affect multinational companies operating in Europe. Germany is the bloc's largest economy and a major contributor.

nd5d08dfca0.headline: Major update over government push for UK households to invest in shares
nd5d08dfca0.summary: Ad agency WPP has been asked to work on a campaign nudging UK savers to invest in shares. The government's push aims to encourage household share ownership.
nd5d08dfca0.why: Encouraging retail share ownership affects savings flows into UK equities and the wider capital markets. WPP is a major global advertising and marketing group.

n0f4ec7f0aa.headline: Defence spending not enough to lift Canada out of a recession: report
n0f4ec7f0aa.summary: A newly released report forecasts that Ottawa's ramped-up defence spending will lift the economy but not enough to avoid a recession. The outlook points to weak growth in Canada.
n0f4ec7f0aa.why: Canada's economy depends heavily on trade, natural resources and housing, and recession forecasts influence Bank of Canada policy and the Canadian dollar.

n97606b1315.headline: Ringgit slips further on US tariff uncertainty
n97606b1315.summary: Sentiment on the ringgit weakened further due to Malaysia's current trade standing with the United States, according to an analyst. The currency continued to slip.
n97606b1315.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its value is sensitive to trade flows and foreign investment sentiment. Tariff uncertainty with the US, a major trade partner, can weigh on it.

n14366b3246.headline: South Korea wins UK appeal over arbitration ruling in Samsung merger case
n14366b3246.summary: South Korea won its latest appeal against U.S. hedge fund Elliott over the 2015 merger of two Samsung affiliates. The win came shortly after Chairman Jay Y. Lee was cleared by South Korea's top court.
n14366b3246.why: Samsung Electronics is South Korea's largest conglomerate and a major global chipmaker, so governance and legal disputes over its affiliates draw investor attention.

nfc7e08de52.headline: Breakfast News: TSMC Flags AI Demand
nfc7e08de52.summary: TSMC posted robust results and flagged continued AI demand, according to a market news roundup. Other items in the report included the Trump-Powell dispute and upcoming Netflix earnings.
nfc7e08de52.why: TSMC is the world's largest contract chipmaker, and its orders reflect demand for advanced chips used in AI systems.
nfc7e08de52.why_moved: Robust results and comments flagging AI demand are cited as the key signals for the chipmaker.

nf33311eae0.headline: Samsung chairman cleared of fraud by South Korea
nf33311eae0.summary: South Korea cleared Samsung chairman Jay Y. Lee of fraud, a decision that will let him focus more of his attention on Samsung.
nf33311eae0.why: Samsung Electronics is South Korea's largest company and a global leader in memory chips and smartphones, so leadership stability matters to investors.

n7c31d5f06f.headline: Japanese car exports to US dive in June as tariffs bite
n7c31d5f06f.summary: Japanese car exports to the US fell more than 25% in June, official data showed. The decline came amid concern that Tokyo has failed to strike a deal to avoid the worst of US tariffs.
n7c31d5f06f.why: Japan is one of the largest car exporters to the United States, so tariffs directly affect automakers' revenue and the trade balance. Trade data signals pressure on the wider Japanese economy.

n7bd229b7ae.headline: Trade deals must support economic reforms and growth, says minister
n7bd229b7ae.summary: Trade Minister Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz said poor deals would have long-term repercussions for Malaysia. He said Putrajaya applies several principles when negotiating with the US.
n7bd229b7ae.why: Malaysia is a trade-dependent economy, and its trade agreements with the US affect tariffs, investment flows and supply chains for exporters.

n1cb5cf5c40.headline: Stock Market Today: Stocks higher on big earnings, better retail sales
n1cb5cf5c40.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq closed at fresh record highs. GE Aerospace raised its guidance, Taiwan Semiconductor reported a record profit, and retail sales rebounded while jobless claims fell.
n1cb5cf5c40.why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark for large US equities, and the Nasdaq tracks major technology stocks. Taiwan Semiconductor is a leading contract chipmaker whose results signal demand for advanced semiconductors.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The index closed at a fresh record high on the day's earnings and retail sales news.

n40595ca555.headline: Vietnam’s Hai Phong secures $15.5bn in new investment commitments
n40595ca555.summary: Hai Phong City in northern Vietnam granted investment certificates and signed memoranda of understanding worth US$15.5 billion at an investment promotion conference held on Tuesday.
n40595ca555.why: Hai Phong is a major northern port and industrial hub, and large inward investment commitments shape manufacturing, logistics and infrastructure growth.

n2ae5928737.headline: Relief for 12 million workers: Credit card tax break set for extension
n2ae5928737.summary: Korea's ruling party may extend a popular tax deduction that serves over 12 million workers as an extra paycheck, to prevent further weakening of consumer spending, according to the report.
n2ae5928737.why: Tax deductions for card spending affect household disposable income and consumption, which are key drivers of Korea's domestic economy.

n263919de9a.headline: Two years in, Hanwha mulls sale of Five Guys Korea
n263919de9a.summary: Hanwha Galleria, the retail arm of Hanwha Group, is reportedly exploring the sale of FG Korea, which operates the US burger chain Five Guys in South Korea, two years after acquiring it.
n263919de9a.why: Hanwha Group is a large South Korean conglomerate, and portfolio sales by its retail arm affect its restaurant and retail holdings.

nb934ed97b5.headline: [Good Business] Flying high: How regional airports can land inclusive growth
nb934ed97b5.summary: The Marcos administration plans to involve the private sector in regional airport development, a plan that presents challenges but could bring significant benefits if managed well, the commentary said.
nb934ed97b5.why: Public-private partnerships in airports bring private capital into transport infrastructure, affecting airport operators and aviation connectivity.

nceb5c019ce.headline: 4,300 lots in Broadway Plan and Cambie Plan to be proactively rezoned by City | Daily Hive | Urbanized
nceb5c019ce.summary: The City of Vancouver will proactively rezone nearly 4,300 properties within the Broadway Plan and Cambie Corridor Plan areas, the city announced.
nceb5c019ce.why: Rezoning changes permitted development density, which affects land values, housing supply and construction activity in the city.

n8050eb28c8.headline: Vancouver mayor seeks to unlock development potential of five 'exceptional' sites | Daily Hive | Urbanized
n8050eb28c8.summary: Mayor Ken Sim is seeking to unlock the development potential of five sites currently set aside for industrial uses, which he describes as exceptional.
n8050eb28c8.why: Rezoning city-owned or designated industrial land can change development pipelines and property values in a constrained housing and commercial market.

nca000a1374.headline: ‘A huge problem,’ Canada’s income gap hits alarming new high, here’s what experts say must change
nca000a1374.summary: The income gap between the highest- and lowest-income families in Canada has reached a record high this year. Experts quoted in the report said the trend must change.
nca000a1374.why: Income inequality shapes consumer spending patterns, labour policy and the political debate over fiscal measures.

n501fc8290a.headline: 60 per cent of Canadian mortgage owners could face higher mortgage payments by 2026: Bank of Canada
n501fc8290a.summary: A Bank of Canada report says roughly 60 per cent of mortgage holders will face higher monthly payments when loans renew in 2025 and 2026. The renewals are a key risk for household finances.
n501fc8290a.why: Mortgage renewals reset borrowing costs for households, and their payment changes affect consumer spending and bank lending risk.

ndfb68c75e4.headline: Eliminating interprovincial trade barriers would add 30K annual housing starts: CMHC
ndfb68c75e4.summary: A CMHC analysis estimates that eliminating interprovincial trade barriers could add 30,000 housing starts annually in Canada. The national housing agency published the analysis.
ndfb68c75e4.why: Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation is the federal housing agency, and its estimates inform housing supply policy and construction activity.

nef06d86f4c.headline: Tech stocks help boost S&P/TSX composite
nef06d86f4c.summary: Canada's main stock index rose more than 200 points at the close of Thursday's session, helped by strength in the technology sector, while U.S. stock markets also climbed.
nef06d86f4c.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's principal benchmark index, covering the bulk of the country's listed equity market value.

nef09ff502a.headline: Zigly launches its first pet hospital and experience center in Mumbai
nef09ff502a.summary: Zigly, India's first tech-enabled omnichannel pet care brand, expanded its operations with the launch of its first pet hospital and experience center in Mumbai.
nef09ff502a.why: Expansion of tech-enabled healthcare services reflects growing consumer demand and innovation in Indian pet care markets.

nf0e437f29a.headline: Libya’s “Blue Homeland” Push: Submitting Continental Shelf Boundaries to the UN, Challenging Greece and Egypt
nf0e437f29a.summary: Libya, guided by Turkey, submitted a Note Verbale to the UN claiming continental shelf boundaries up to Crete, contesting Greece’s and Egypt’s maritime rights and declaring their EEZ agreements illegal.
nf0e437f29a.why: Maritime boundary disputes affect regional energy exploration and geopolitical stability, impacting energy markets and international trade routes.

nd6c5dfccc1.headline: STL leads the way in sustainable optical fibre manufacturing with Green Hydrogen
nd6c5dfccc1.summary: STL has partnered with Hygenco to produce Maharashtra's first green hydrogen and green oxygen facility, advancing sustainable optical fibre manufacturing.
nd6c5dfccc1.why: STL is a global leader in optical solutions; sustainability initiatives align with global ESG trends and can reduce operational costs.

naad4caa3f2.headline: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman assures SoftBank Group founder Masayoshi Son about AI’s increasing demand in coming days: ‘... seems to be huge’
naad4caa3f2.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman assured SoftBank founder Masayoshi Son that AI demand will increase significantly, requiring more computing capacity.
naad4caa3f2.why: AI technology growth drives demand for computing infrastructure and investment in tech sectors globally.

impacts.name: SoftBank Group
impacts.why: SoftBank's investment exposure to AI may benefit from rising demand.

ne6b0c25f4f.summary: Indian indices closed lower as IT shares fell, with the Sensex down 375 points and the Nifty losing 100 points. Investors were focused on Axis Bank and Wipro quarterly results.

n420e718f35.summary: Dollar rates at Kazakh currency exchanges have started rising sharply, according to National Bank data for 17 July. The official rate stood at 526.50 tenge per dollar.
n420e718f35.why: The tenge is Kazakhstan's currency, and sharp moves against the dollar affect import costs, inflation and the value of dollar-denominated assets held in the country.

n597087a53e.summary: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni set a goal of one million more jobs in 1,000 days while speaking at the national congress of CISL, a major trade union.
n597087a53e.why: Employment targets and labour policy shape Italy's growth outlook and the fiscal and labour-market assumptions investors watch.

n4cd4b1eba4.summary: Minister Đedović said at the Energy Community meeting in Athens that Serbia has met prerequisites to connect its electricity market with the European market, with the EU to complete its part.
n4cd4b1eba4.why: Market coupling with the EU can change electricity prices, cross-border flows and investment conditions for power producers in the Balkans.
